positions.title: Firmware Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a firmware analysis tool to extract run time data without compiling source or deploying firmware executables. Deployed into CI/CD pipeline for seamless integration with firmware development. [PYTHON]

Developed a circular buffer firmware module and driver for infinite data logging and retrieval to an eternal flash SPI IC. Extensibility and modularity primary factors for design. [C]
